name: Cliff at Lyons
setting: Converted mill village with waterfall and gardens
acoustics: Intimate stone walls with excellent natural acoustics. The lower ceiling creates a warm, contained sound.
setup_notes: Load-in through the courtyard. Setup in The Mill is straightforward with good power access.
best_for: Couples who want rustic elegance with a village feel. The waterfall makes for stunning photos.
insider_tip: The outdoor ceremony space by the waterfall is magical but can be breezy - have a backup plan for the string quartet.
testimonial: We got married at Cliff at Lyons and The Beat Boutique knew the venue perfectly. They set up seamlessly and had everyone dancing all night.

name: Ballybeg House
setting: Georgian country house with walled gardens
acoustics: The converted barn has high ceilings and exposed beams. Sound carries well but needs management to avoid echo.
setup_notes: Good vehicle access. The barn has ample space for full band setup plus dance floor.
best_for: Garden parties with a country house feel. The walled garden ceremonies are beautiful.
insider_tip: The barn can get warm in summer with a full crowd dancing - the venue has fans but we adjust our breaks accordingly.
testimonial: The band filled Ballybeg's barn with amazing energy. Our guests are still talking about the music months later.

name: Mount Juliet Estate
setting: Historic estate with championship golf course
acoustics: Large, elegant room with excellent acoustics. High ceilings allow sound to breathe without echo.
setup_notes: Professional venue staff who know exactly what bands need. Load-in is well organised.
best_for: Larger weddings with a sophisticated, estate feel. The grounds are spectacular for photos.
insider_tip: The Lady Helen Suite works perfectly for a 5-piece band. Request the dance floor position near the windows for best atmosphere.
testimonial: Mount Juliet was stunning and The Beat Boutique matched the venue's elegance while getting everyone on their feet.

name: Powerscourt Hotel
setting: Luxury hotel with views of Sugar Loaf mountain
acoustics: Purpose-built ballroom with excellent sound. Professional in-house AV team available.
setup_notes: Hotel has dedicated loading bay and staff familiar with band requirements. Very smooth setup.
best_for: Large weddings that want five-star service. The views and grounds are breathtaking.
insider_tip: The McGill Suite works beautifully for more intimate weddings of 100-120. Same great service, cosier atmosphere.
testimonial: Powerscourt and The Beat Boutique - the perfect combination. Professional, seamless, and unforgettable.

name: Kilshane House
setting: Romantic Georgian house with stunning conservatory
acoustics: The glass conservatory is visually stunning but needs careful sound management. We adjust our setup for this space.
setup_notes: Load-in through the service entrance. The team at Kilshane are exceptionally helpful.
best_for: Couples who want romantic, photogenic surroundings. The conservatory at night is magical.
insider_tip: For winter weddings, the ballroom creates a more intimate atmosphere. Summer weddings in the conservatory are hard to beat.
testimonial: Kilshane House looked incredible and the band made it feel even more special. Couldn't have asked for more.

name: Bellingham Castle
acoustics: Stone walls and high ceilings create a dramatic sound. We love playing here - the room responds to live music beautifully.
setup_notes: Castle staff are experienced with weddings. Setup in the Great Hall is straightforward.
best_for: Couples who want castle grandeur without stuffiness. Bellingham manages to be both impressive and welcoming.
insider_tip: The outdoor ceremony space is gorgeous but check the weather backup. The Great Hall works for ceremonies too.
testimonial: The castle setting with live music was everything we dreamed of. The Beat Boutique understood exactly what we wanted.

name: Ballymagarvey Village
setting: Restored 18th century grain mill and village
acoustics: Converted barn with excellent natural sound. High ceilings and stone create warm acoustics.
setup_notes: Dedicated band area with good power. The venue team are very experienced.
best_for: Couples who want rustic charm with modern convenience. The village setting is unique.
insider_tip: The courtyard between buildings creates a natural flow. We often see guests drifting between spaces all night.
testimonial: Ballymagarvey felt like our own private village for the weekend. The band made the Grain Store come alive.

name: Tinakilly House
setting: Victorian Italianate mansion with sea views
acoustics: Elegant room with good natural acoustics. The wooden floors are great for dancing.
setup_notes: Helpful venue staff. Load-in through side entrance keeps the front of house pristine.
best_for: Sea-view ceremonies and Victorian elegance. Close to Dublin but feels like an escape.
insider_tip: The sea views at sunset are stunning for photos. Time your ceremony to catch the light.
testimonial: Tinakilly was beautiful and intimate. The band matched the venue perfectly - elegant but fun.

name: Virginia Park Lodge
setting: Lakeside Georgian lodge with Richard Corrigan
acoustics: Well-proportioned room with balanced sound. The wooden floors are ideal for dancing.
setup_notes: The team at Virginia Park are incredibly professional. Everything runs like clockwork.
best_for: Food-focused couples - Richard Corrigan's team deliver exceptional dining. The lakeside setting is peaceful.
insider_tip: The food is the star here, so we work with the kitchen on timing. The post-dinner party is always high-energy.
testimonial: Virginia Park Lodge exceeded every expectation - the food, the setting, and the music. Perfect.

name: Trudder Lodge
setting: Elegant country house with contemporary style
acoustics: Intimate spaces that suit our band well. Summer marquee weddings have their own atmosphere.
setup_notes: Smaller venue so we adapt our setup. The team are accommodating and experienced.
best_for: Intimate weddings with style. The interiors are magazine-worthy.
insider_tip: Trudder works best for weddings under 120. The intimacy is part of the charm.
testimonial: Trudder Lodge was exactly our style - small, stylish, and personal. The band made it feel like the best house party ever.
